answer: The ledge holds work receipts rather than names, so the mirror of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The dune of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
